To answer this question, we rstly analyzed the underlying cause of this negative h. One can see that DG₅ is 0.64 eV, and the total free energy change of the four electro- chemical steps is 4.28 eV. This means that these electro- chemical reactions can be carried forward with an applied electrode potential lower than 1.23 V.
